title: Strides Pharma Q2 Revenue Rises 17.1% to Rs 1,430 Crore as Ex-US Markets Overtake US Business

contentHtml:
Bengaluru: Strides Pharma Science Limited reported a 17.1 per cent year-on-year increase in consolidated revenue to Rs 14,297 million (Rs 1,429.7 crore) for the second quarter of FY2027, driven by 31 per cent growth in its Ex-US markets. For the first time, revenue from the Ex-US markets surpassed the company's US business during a quarter. EBITDA increased 8.4 per cent year-on-year to Rs 2,509 million (Rs 250.9 crore), crossing the Rs 2,500 million mark for the first time in a quarter.

For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the company's US business generated revenue of Rs 6,855 million (USD 73 million), registering 9 per cent year-on-year growth. The Ex-US markets recorded revenue of Rs 6,963 million (USD 74 million), reflecting a 31 per cent increase compared with the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year. The company also launched three products in the US market during the quarter.

Strides Pharma's gross margin increased 13.4 per cent year-on-year to Rs 8,003 million in Q2FY27, compared with Rs 7,056 million in Q2FY26. However, the gross margin percentage declined by 180 basis points to 56 per cent from 57.8 per cent in the corresponding quarter last year. Compared with the previous quarter, gross margin increased 3.9 per cent from Rs 7,702 million, while the gross margin percentage declined by 490 basis points from 60.9 per cent.

EBITDA stood at Rs 2,509 million during Q2FY27, against Rs 2,316 million in Q2FY26, registering 8.4 per cent growth. On a sequential basis, EBITDA increased 9.2 per cent from Rs 2,298 million in Q1FY27. The EBITDA margin was 17.6 per cent, compared with 19 per cent in the year-ago quarter and 18.2 per cent in the preceding quarter. The company reported that EBITDA growth was achieved despite higher input material and freight costs.

Operational profit after tax (PAT) increased 11.5 per cent year-on-year to Rs 1,358 million, compared with Rs 1,218 million in Q2FY26. Operational earnings per share (EPS) rose 11.6 per cent to Rs 14.7 from Rs 13.2. Sequentially, operational PAT increased 10.3 per cent from Rs 1,231 million, while operational EPS also rose 10.3 per cent from Rs 13.4.

Reported PAT for the quarter stood at Rs 1,341 million, registering a 2 per cent increase over Rs 1,315 million in Q2FY26. Reported EPS increased 2.6 per cent to Rs 14.2 from Rs 13.8. Compared with Q1FY27, reported PAT declined 19 per cent from Rs 1,655 million, while reported EPS decreased 16.6 per cent from Rs 17.

For the first half of FY2027, Strides Pharma recorded consolidated revenue of Rs 26,951 million, up 15.1 per cent from Rs 23,406 million in H1FY26. Gross margin increased 13.7 per cent to Rs 15,705 million from Rs 13,810 million, while the gross margin percentage stood at 58.3 per cent against 59 per cent in the corresponding period.

H1FY27 EBITDA increased 6.9 per cent to Rs 4,807 million from Rs 4,496 million. The EBITDA margin was 17.8 per cent, compared with 19.2 per cent in H1FY26. Operational PAT rose 9.8 per cent to Rs 2,589 million from Rs 2,358 million, while operational EPS increased 9.9 per cent to Rs 28.1 from Rs 25.6.

Reported PAT for the first half of FY2027 increased 26.4 per cent to Rs 2,996 million, compared with Rs 2,371 million in the corresponding period last year. Reported EPS rose 26.7 per cent to Rs 31.2 from Rs 24.6. The company clarified that the Q2FY26 and H1FY26 operational PAT and operational EPS figures exclude one-time finance income of Rs 185 million. Operational PAT is calculated as reported PAT excluding exceptional items.

Commenting on the quarterly performance, Badree Komandur, Managing Director and Group Chief Executive Officer of Strides Pharma Science Limited, said the company delivered a strong second quarter, with revenue growing approximately 17 per cent year-on-year, primarily driven by the Ex-US markets. He highlighted that the company's diversification strategy continued to support growth, with Ex-US revenue increasing 31 per cent and exceeding US business revenue for the first time in a quarter. He also noted that the US business recorded 9 per cent growth.

Komandur stated that EBITDA crossed Rs 2,500 million for the first time in a quarter despite higher raw material, freight and operating costs arising from geopolitical disruptions. The company is focusing on continuous cost optimisation initiatives to mitigate these pressures during the year.

He further stated that net debt increased by Rs 2,114 million during the first half of FY2027 due to an elongated cash-to-cash cycle and higher inventory holding to navigate prevailing market conditions. The company expects its net debt-to-EBITDA ratio to stabilise by the end of the year.

The company also welcomed Biren Gabhawala to its Board as an Independent Director. Komandur stated that Gabhawala's expertise in financial reporting, audit and corporate governance would strengthen the Board's oversight. He added that despite the dynamic external environment, Strides remains committed to delivering sustainable and profitable growth.

Strides Pharma Science Limited is a global pharmaceutical com mkpany headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and listed on BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The company primarily operates in regulated markets and follows an “in Africa for Africa” strategy, alongside an institutional business serving donor-funded markets.

Its global manufacturing facilities are located in India, including Chennai, Puducherry and two locations in Bengaluru, as well as Milan in Italy, Nairobi in Kenya and New York in the United States. The company focuses on difficult-to-manufacture pharmaceutical products that are marketed in more than 100 countries.
